environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SEZNAM_SKLIK_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Sklik API Fénix refresh token (log in at https://www.sklik.cz/ > Tools > API > create token; you choose its validity and access level r / rw). Exchanged at POST https://api.sklik.cz/v1/user/token (grant_type=refresh_token, form) for a 1-hour access token, re-requested on expiry or 401; the token acts on the refresh token owner's own Sklik account.
